cards.title: Why madge couldn't show this reliably
items: madge silently failed to parse the largest route file (2,493 lines) — a real, confirmed parser limitation, not a config issue
This diagram is hand-verified against the actual directory listing instead

cards.title: The cloud seam is real, not aspirational
items: lib/cloud/ components are committed stub files ('replaced wholesale by the commercial overlay at image-build time')
Every usage is additionally gated by isCloudEdition, so community builds tree-shake it out entirely

cards.title: One HTTP client, not several
items: lib/axios.ts is the single axios instance — httpOnly cookie auth, no JS-readable token
stores/auth.ts imports it back via a dynamic import specifically to break a load-order cycle (see Findings)
